acceptance: Global core.hooksPath hooks do not fire during store init even on Git 2.28-2.30, or the declared minimum Git version is raised to 2.31.
A test verifies hook suppression across supported Git versions.
context: Discovered during store init isolation testing (test_inherited_git_environment_and_global_hooks_are_ignored). GIT_CONFIG_COUNT requires Git >= 2.31.
description: git init fires global core.hooksPath hooks before the repository's local config can be written. open() sets GIT_CONFIG_COUNT / GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=core.hooksPath to /dev/null in the environment to isolate the init command, but GIT_CONFIG_COUNT requires Git >= 2.31. On Git 2.28 to 2.30, an installed global reference-transaction hook will still fire during git init. Either raise the minimum Git version to 2.31 or initialize stores with a template directory that disables hooks.
